exchanges.q: Thank you for coming. Before we start, do you agree that we record this session?
How long were you married to {ABUSER}?
exchanges.a: We were married for eleven years. We lived together in {TOWN} until 2023.
About two years after the wedding. At first he only shouted, but later he started to hit me.

exchanges.q: Did you ever ask the police for help?
a: Yes, two times. The first time they told me it was a family matter.
The second time they wrote a report, but nobody came to the house.

exchanges.q: Do you have a copy of that report?
exchanges.a: No, I don't have it. Maybe my mother can ask for it at the station.

exchanges.q: Did he ever threaten you with a weapon?
exchanges.a: Once, in December 2022. He held a knife and said he would kill me if I left him.

exchanges.q: Who else knew what was happening?
exchanges.a: My neighbor knew, and my sister {SISTER}. I think my sister told our parents, but I'm not sure.

exchanges.q: Why did you decide to leave the country and not only the town?
a: Because his cousin is a police officer.
Wherever I went, he could find me through his cousin.

exchanges.q: In your declaration you wrote that you left in March. Is that correct?
exchanges.a: No, it was April. I left on the second of April 2023. The declaration has a mistake.

exchanges.q: What do you fear would happen if you go back?
exchanges.a: I am afraid that he will kill me. He told my mother that I will pay for leaving.
